description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ViewAdminsettings' which extends 'SugarView' and manages the administrative settings interface for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system, specifically related to SugarFeed configuration. It includes methods for rendering the settings page, processing form submissions, and interacting with system settings and Modules.

classes.name: ViewAdminsettings
classes.description: Defines the admin settings view for SugarFeed related configurations within the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the module tab name 'Administration' for the settings page.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Provides the breadcrumbs or title parameters for display, including a link to the Administration module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles displaying the admin settings page, processing form submissions, updating configurations, and rendering the Smarty template with current settings.
